cohort: 60 pregnant women at term who required labour induction at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Madurai Medical College.
finding: Isosorbide Mononitrate (IMN) was found to be a safer and more effective alternative to Dinoprostone Gel (PGE2) for cervical ripening, resulting in a lower risk of maternal hyperstimulation and neonatal complications, despite being associated with a longer induction-to-delivery interval.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was achieved in all IMN cases, whereas 20% of PGE2 cases required caesarean delivery.
